key.name: hotkey
key.description: Global hotkey that toggles the OneSwitch popup.

key.name: hide-titlebar
key.description: When enabled, window title bars are hidden when maximized/tiled/always, and the title is shown in the top panel instead.

key.name: titlebar-hide-mode
key.description: When to hide the title bar: 'maximized' (when fully maximized), 'always' (always), or 'tiled' (when tiled or maximized).

key.name: panel-show-title
key.description: When the title bar is hidden, show the window title in the top panel.

key.name: panel-show-buttons
key.description: When the title bar is hidden, show window control buttons (close, minimize, maximize) in the top panel.
